title: Marguerite and the Machine
author: R. M. Yarrow
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
